svg.aria-label: Schematic diagram, not to scale, showing the three colonial regions from north to south: New England, Middle Colonies, Southern Colonies
svg.title: Colonial regions schematic — not to scale
svg.desc: Schematic only, not a geographic map. Three stacked bands run north to south: New England at the top, Middle Colonies in the middle, Southern Colonies at the bottom. Each band is labeled with its region name and colonies. No borders or coastlines are drawn.
svg.text: Colonial regions — schematic, NOT to scale
New Hampshire · Massachusetts · Rhode Island · Connecticut
New York · New Jersey · Pennsylvania · Delaware
Maryland · Virginia · North Carolina · South Carolina · Georgia
Atlantic coast runs along the right side. Bands show order only — no real borders drawn.
